system.description:
You receive a +1 SR bonus for your skills tagged with [Support][Song of Aid] (this can exceed the maximum SR). If your attack target is in the [Dazed][Confused][Afflicted] status, you gain a +2D bonus to the damage roll against that target. Fairy-Weaving Cloak, a magical coat said to be worn by fairies who traverse human dreams. Grants the wearer the ability to accurately read an enemy's mental weaknesses.
